records.Concise description: Bitcoin-native marketplace for physical and digital Bitcoin goods using collateralized auctions and fixed-price sales.
records.Deeper researched summary: Scarce City predates the Ordinals marketplace boom and applies Bitcoin-native incentives to commerce. Its official About page describes auctions where bidders collateralize bids with refundable Lightning or Bitcoin mainchain deposits, with forfeiture for a winning bidder who fails to pay. Its fixed-price marketplace similarly uses refundable seller collateral rather than taking custody of goods. Scarce City sells physical Bitcoin art/collectibles as well as digital/Ordinal goods, so it is not a conventional PSBT inscription order book and should not be described as one.
Creators / founders: Chiefmonkey (honorary founder / original auction idea, per Scarce City)
records.Launch / history: Founded before the 2023 Ordinals wave and later expanded its established Bitcoin auctions into Ordinal/digital-art sales alongside physical goods.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin marketplac: Scarce City is culturally significant because it uses Bitcoin and Lightning as marketplace coordination/collateral rails for Bitcoin-native art and collectibles, providing a different marketplace model from PSBT-based digital-asset venues.

Official sources.label: Scarce City submissions and sale mechanics

records.Verification basis: Current About, active sale/collection pages and terms were checked.
Research notes / uncertainties: Scarce City may hold or release sale proceeds depending on sale format and delivery confirmation; do not call the whole platform non-custodial. Its seller-collateral model for goods is structurally different from atomic PSBT inscription settlement.

records.Concise description: Unspendable Labs marketplace for Counterparty assets and newer Ordinals trading, with signed listings and atomic-swap APIs.
records.Deeper researched summary: Horizon Market is operated by Unspendable Labs Inc. and began from the Counterparty ecosystem rather than the 2023 Ordinals wave. Horizon 2.0 relaunched in August 2025; Ordinal inscriptions went live March 28, 2026. The Ordinals flow creates and signs a PSBT/atomic-swap listing, and July 2026 releases opened the atomic-swap REST API and TypeScript client for embedding trust-minimized Bitcoin trading. Current terms emphasize that Horizon Market does not custody customer Bitcoin or assets and functions as a signed-listing tool rather than an exchange, while Horizon Wallet is documented separately as a signing interface.
Creators / founders: Unspendable Labs Inc.; individual founders were not established from reviewed first-party materials
records.Launch / history: Horizon 2.0 announced August 4, 2025; embedded wallet December 2025; Ordinals marketplace support March 28, 2026; public atomic-swap API July 7, 2026; TypeScript Market Client July 15, 2026.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin marketplac: Horizon broadens the canon beyond Ordinals-only venues by connecting older Bitcoin-native collectible protocols such as Counterparty with contemporary Ordinals in a non-custodial signed-order/atomic-swap architecture.
records.Verification basis: Current legal terms, dated 2025–2026 product announcements and wallet separation were checked.
Research notes / uncertainties: The January 2026 Terms still foreground Counterparty; later dated first-party posts establish subsequent Ordinals support. Treat the legal 'not an exchange' language as a legal/product description, not a claim that no software coordination exists. Asset protocol support beyond what current posts explicitly establish should be rechecked before public copy.

records.Entity / project type: Retired Bitcoin marketplace implementation of a multi-chain marketplace
records.Concise description: Historically major Magic Eden marketplace implementation for Bitcoin Ordinals and Runes, shut down in March 2026.
records.Deeper researched summary: Magic Eden launched native Bitcoin Ordinals marketplace support in March 2023 and became one of the most influential Ordinals trading venues. It later added Runes and Bitcoin APIs. In 2026 Magic Eden changed strategy: its own Help Center states marketplace support for Bitcoin ended March 9, Bitcoin/Runes APIs and remaining Bitcoin services ended March 27, and only the Solana marketplace remained among the former chain marketplaces. Bitcoin listings, bids and offers had off-chain components, and the wind-down required users to withdraw BTC from bidding/auction wallets. This record therefore preserves the Bitcoin implementation as HISTORICAL without implying that Magic Eden the company is inactive.
Creators / founders: Magic Eden team; Bitcoin implementation was part of the existing Magic Eden company rather than a separate company
records.Launch / history: Bitcoin Ordinals marketplace launched March 21, 2023. It grew into a major Ordinals venue and later supported Runes. Bitcoin marketplace support ended March 9, 2026; Bitcoin/Runes APIs and remaining services ended March 27, 2026.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin marketplac: Magic Eden helped move Ordinals from niche early PSBT venues into a mainstream multi-chain NFT marketplace and materially shaped liquidity, UX and creator-marketplace competition before its Bitcoin exit.
records.Verification basis: Official 2026 shutdown notice controls lifecycle status; independent contemporary research establishes launch and historical significance.
Research notes / uncertainties: Do not present old Magic Eden Bitcoin pages, old fee tables or stale indexed collections as current service. This HISTORICAL status applies only to the Bitcoin marketplace implementation; Magic Eden's Solana marketplace continued after the 2026 wind-down.

records.Entity / project type: Retired Bitcoin marketplace features across Binance NFT/Web3 Wallet
records.Concise description: Historical Binance marketplace support for Bitcoin Ordinals/inscriptions across multiple Binance product phases.
records.Deeper researched summary: Binance had more than one Bitcoin collectible-marketplace phase. Binance NFT added Bitcoin Ordinals support in May 2023 through an exchange-account experience; Binance later discontinued Bitcoin NFT trading and deposits in April 2024. Separately, Binance Web3 Wallet exposed an Inscriptions Marketplace for BRC-20 and related inscriptions. A Binance Academy page updated June 2026 says users may browse previously purchased inscriptions but can no longer place new buy or sell orders. MSC therefore consolidates the corporate/product history into one HISTORICAL record rather than inventing multiple canonical Binance marketplace entities.
Creators / founders: Binance team; no separate Bitcoin-marketplace founding team
records.Launch / history: Binance NFT announced/added Bitcoin Ordinals in May 2023, ended Bitcoin NFT trading in April 2024, and later operated a Web3 Wallet Inscriptions Marketplace whose new buy/sell orders are no longer available by June 2026.
records.Why it matters in the Bitcoin marketplac: Binance is historically important because a global centralized exchange brought Ordinals to exchange-account users and later experimented with a wallet-side inscription marketplace, illustrating two distinct custody/UX models.
